title: Change board, Pinerolo
utterances: Third porosity escape on HB-620 from Fonderia Dora this quarter, the 8D is still open.
Then I revoke Dora's approval for HB-620 today and set Dora to conditional.
Agreed. We move HB-620 to Fonderia Pellice once their audit and PPAP are through.
Pellice can start in October if the audit passes.

decisions.text: Revoke SUP-D approval for HB-620, move HB-620 to SUP-H after qualification.
decisions.reason: Three porosity escapes with 8D-26-009 still open.
decisions.quote: We move HB-620 to Fonderia Pellice once their audit and PPAP are through.
